title: Set 232

sentences.ko: 오늘 회의에서 회사 어떤 사람이 내 아이디어를 자기 거라고 했어. 그것도 바로 내 앞에서. 근데 너무 어이가 없어서 아무 말도 못 했어. 지금은 그 사람보다 나 자신한테 더 화가 나.
sentences.text: So this guy at work took credit for my idea in the meeting today, like right in front of me, and I didn't say anything because I was so shocked. And now I'm more mad at myself than I am at him.

alts.text: Ugh, some guy at work stole my idea in the meeting today, right in front of me, and I just froze and said nothing. Honestly I'm madder at myself than at him.
A colleague took credit for my idea in the meeting today, directly in front of me, and I did not say anything because I was so shocked. Now I am more upset with myself than I am with him.

sentences.note: **took credit for** 는 남의 공을 가로채다라는 뜻입니다. **more mad at myself than I am at him** 은 그 사람보다 나한테 더 화난다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 회사 사람 때문에 짜증난 걸 친구한테 털어놓기

sentences.ko: 퇴근하고 달리기하려고 했는데 결국 늦게까지 일하게 됐고, 집에 왔을 땐 이미 밥을 먹은 뒤라서 그냥 내일 아침에 가기로 했어.
sentences.text: I was going to go for a run after work, but I ended up staying late, and by the time I got home I'd already eaten, so I figured I'd just go tomorrow morning instead.

alts.text: Meant to run after work, but I got stuck late, and I'd already eaten by the time I got home, so eh, tomorrow morning.
I had intended to go for a run after work, but I ended up staying late, and by the time I arrived home I had already eaten, so I decided to go tomorrow morning instead.

sentences.note: **ended up** 은 원래 생각과 다르게 결국 그렇게 됐다는 뜻입니다. **by the time** 은 ~할 즈음에는 이라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

sentences.ko: 일요일에 공원에서 생일 파티 하기로 했었는데, 하루 종일 비가 온대서 우리 집에서 하게 됐어. 스무 명을 다 어디에 들여야 할지 진짜 모르겠어.
sentences.text: We were supposed to do the birthday thing in the park on Sunday, but it's going to rain all day, so now it's at my place, and I have no idea where I'm going to put twenty people.

alts.text: The birthday thing was gonna be in the park Sunday, but it's supposed to rain all day, so now it's at my place, and I've got no clue where I'm putting twenty people.
We had planned to hold the birthday celebration in the park on Sunday, but it is expected to rain all day, so it will now be at my home, and I am not sure where I will fit twenty people.

sentences.note: **were supposed to** 는 원래 ~하기로 되어 있었다는 뜻입니다. **I have no idea** 는 전혀 모르겠다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 응, 드디어 귀 검사 받았어. 알고 보니 그냥 귀지였더라. 좀 창피해. 귀가 점점 안 들리는 줄 알고 일주일을 지냈거든.
sentences.text: Yeah, I finally got my ear checked. Turns out it was just wax, which is kind of embarrassing, because I'd been walking around for a week thinking I was losing my hearing.

alts.text: Finally got my ear checked. It was just wax, which is kinda embarrassing, 'cause I spent a whole week thinking I was going deaf.
I finally had my ear examined. It turned out to be only wax, which is somewhat embarrassing, because I had spent a week believing that I was losing my hearing.

sentences.note: **Turns out** 는 알고 보니 라는 뜻입니다. **losing my hearing** 은 청력을 잃어 간다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 병원 갔다 온 얘기 가볍게 하기

sentences.ko: 응, 아빠, 다 괜찮아요. 요즘 일이 좀 정신없긴 한데 감당 못 할 정도는 아니니까 제 걱정은 하지 마세요, 알았죠? 허리는 좀 어떠세요?
sentences.text: Yeah, Dad, everything's fine. Work's been a little crazy, but it's nothing I can't handle, so don't worry about me, okay? How's your back doing?

alts.text: Dad, I'm fine, really. Work's been kinda nuts, but I can handle it, so don't worry, okay? How's your back?
Yes, Dad, everything is fine. Work has been rather hectic, but it is nothing I cannot manage, so please do not worry about me. How is your back?

sentences.note: **nothing I can't handle** 는 내가 감당 못 할 일은 아니다라는 뜻입니다. **How's your back doing?** 은 허리 상태가 어떤지 묻는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 부모님 안부 전화에서 잘 지낸다고 둘러대기

reviewed: 2번 casual 이 I was gonna run after work 로 시작해 text 의 앞부분과 거의 같아서, Meant to run after work 로 시작하게 바꿈
2번 한국어의 뛰려고는 달리기하려고로, 늦게까지 남아 있었고는 늦게까지 일하게 됐고로 바꿔 자연스럽게 다듬음
3번 casual 의 it's raining all day 는 지금 비가 온다는 말로 들려 일요일 예보라는 뜻이 사라짐. it's supposed to rain all day 로 고침
3번 한국어의 하나도 모르겠어는 어색해서 스무 명을 다 어디에 들여야 할지 진짜 모르겠어로 고침
4번 한국어의 귀가 안 들리게 되는 줄 알고 다녔거든은 번역투라 귀가 점점 안 들리는 줄 알고 일주일을 지냈거든으로 고침
5번 formal 의 Father 는 예스럽고 어색해서 Dad 로 되돌림. 존댓말 같은 정중함은 말투로만 살림
